content.title: DISASTER RECOVERY
content.content:
- **Ground Plex DR deployment**: Ground Plex nodes can be deployed across AH's primary and secondary data center sites (or across OpenShift availability zones). DR Ground Plex nodes register to the same SnapLogic Org — they are immediately active and can receive workloads if the primary site is unavailable.

- **Manager cloud HA**: The SnapLogic Manager (SaaS) operates with multi-region availability (pipeline definitions/account metadata/schedules are replicated geographically). Manager RPO is a 30-day retention. In a full Manager restoration scenario, RPO is 2 hours and RTO is 48 hours. Customers can also export pipeline packages (`.slpkg`) to their own air-gapped backup system.

- **Stateless Ground Plex recovery**: Ground Plex nodes are fully stateless — they hold no persistent data. A new Ground Plex node, pointed at the same SnapLogic Org, is operational within minutes of deployment. Recovery of the execution layer is independent of the Manager recovery timeline.
